title: Create and inspect a scoped archive
goal: Archive exactly the expected relative members.
challenge: Create one bounded archive of the supplied fixture, with relative regular-file members only. Inspect names and metadata and explain why inspection does not verify payload bytes.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-backup-2; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Guard a fresh, learner-owned workspace and check guest free space. Stop if any command fails.
steps.expected: Private practice directory; at least 65536 KiB available.

steps.command: guard() { test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-backup-2 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-backup-2 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && test -z "$(find . -type l -print -quit)"; }; guard
steps.explanation: Define and use a location/owner guard for every later change.
steps.expected: Exact physical path, not a link.

steps.command: guard && mkdir -m 0700 source && printf 'alpha\n' > source/note.txt && printf 'bravo\n' > 'source/space name.txt' && chmod 0640 source/note.txt && chmod 0600 'source/space name.txt' && touch -d '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' source/note.txt 'source/space name.txt'
steps.explanation: Create two known regular files, including a name with a space.
steps.expected: alpha and bravo lines, modes640/600, fixed UTC timestamp.

steps.command: guard && test ! -e v1.tar && test ! -L v1.tar && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -cf v1.tar -C source -- note.txt 'space name.txt' && test "$(stat -c %s v1.tar)" -le 65536
steps.explanation: -C changes the input directory; explicit names avoid archiving unrelated files. No absolute paths.

steps.command: guard && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -tf v1.tar && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -tvf v1.tar
steps.explanation: List names and header metadata before extraction.
steps.expected: note.txt and space name.txt; no links, parent or absolute paths.

hints: Listing does not compare payloads to the originals.
Check mode and owner shown in the header.
review: Archive names, type/mode/owner headers and size.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 103.3 and LPIC-2 v4.5 206.2 partial manual archives/recovery; 104.5 reinforcement where applicable. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
